verdict.rationale: Kosmos is documented to produce a comprehensive, citable report with publication-ready figures and data visualizations alongside its written analysis, and task artifacts can be reviewed after completion. That is direct report output, but the evidence never describes the report's structure or any way to share it with stakeholders. missing for 10: documented report structure (sections, tables, executive summary), sharing/export to stakeholders (e.g., PDF/link), independent or hands-on corroboration of report quality.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can get a structured report with sections, tables, and a summary that I can share with stakeholders

citations.quote: Kosmos autonomously reads literature, writes and executes analysis code, generates hypotheses, and produces a comprehensive cited report.
Kosmos also generates publication-ready figures and data visualizations alongside its written analysis.
Once the task has completed you may want to check the contents of the notebook or look through the artifacts generated.
